Name: Willy's Apprentice
Author: KushKodiya
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Willy's Apprentice is an in-game item wiki for Stardew Valley. Instead of alt-tabbing to a browser every time you find an item you don't recognize, you hover over it, press a key, and see everything important the wiki would tell you. It reads from data built directly out of the game's own files, so it's always accurate to your game version, and it's completely self-contained: no external programs, no accounts, no setup beyond dropping it in your Mods folder.
This is the first release, focused on the item overlay. It's the foundation for a larger companion tool planned in future updates.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI (the Stardew Valley modding framework) if you don't already have it — get it from smapi.io and follow its installer.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Move the unzipped 
[/color]
[code]WillysApprentice[/code][color=#D4D4D8] folder into your Stardew Valley 
[/color]
[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8] folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI as usual.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Hover over any item and press [b]F5[/b] to see:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]How to craft it[/b] — its recipe and the ingredients you need[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]What it's used to craft[/b] — every recipe the item is an ingredient for[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Bundle requirements[/b] — which community center bundles the item goes toward[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Gift preferences[/b] — which villagers love, like, or dislike receiving it[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]It works across your inventory, chests, shops, and objects placed out in the world — machines, crops, furniture, and more. Coverage spans roughly 2200 items, including regular objects, big craftables, weapons, tools, furniture, and clothing.
The overlay appears in the corner of the screen so it never blocks the item you're looking at, and long entries wrap to stay readable. Press F5 again to dismiss it.
[b]Changing the hotkey:[/b] F5 is the default (it has no vanilla Stardew binding). To use a different key, edit 
[/color]
[code]HotKey[/code][color=#D4D4D8] in the mod's 
[/color]
[code]config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8], which is generated automatically in the mod folder the first time you run it.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/b] — this is the only requirement. The mod is otherwise fully self-contained; all its data ships with it and there's nothing else to install or run.[/color][/*]
[/list]
